overview: Host John Petrella interviewed Medford resident Robert Carney on Medford Happenings regarding civic engagement, local trash pickup policies, the high school building project, and rent control.

items.title: Introduction of Guest Robert Carney
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduced resident Robert Carney to discuss his background and involvement in Medford civic issues.

items.title: HOA Trash Collection Policy
items.summary: Carney explained how a city notice terminating trash pickup for condo townhouses motivated him to organize neighbors, petition city officials, and speak at City Council meetings.

items.title: Civic Engagement and Local Governance
items.summary: Carney shared advice on resident participation and expressed concerns that political slates limit independent decision-making on the City Council.

items.title: Medford High School Rebuild Proposals
items.summary: Carney critiqued the high school project planning, raising questions regarding proposed building size, land-use due diligence, fiscal oversight, and preventative maintenance.

items.title: Rent Control Initiative
items.summary: Carney expressed opposition to a proposed statewide rent control ballot initiative, arguing it would overburden non-owner-occupied landlords and suppress housing investment.
